places.name: Kangaroo Island
places.ai_summary: Kangaroo Island is a pristine natural haven, home to diverse wildlife, stunning beaches, and unique rock formations. It's a must-visit destination for nature lovers.
places.place_tip: Visit Seal Bay Conservation Park to see sea lions up close.
places.address: Kangaroo Island, South Australia, Australia

places.name: Barossa Valley Wine Region
places.ai_summary: The Barossa Valley is one of Australia's premier wine regions, known for its world-class wineries, gourmet food, and picturesque landscapes.
places.place_tip: Take a guided wine tour to explore the best wineries.
places.address: Barossa Valley, South Australia, Australia

attribution.title: Barossa Valley South Australia

places.name: Adelaide Central Market
places.ai_summary: Adelaide Central Market is a food lover's paradise, offering a wide variety of fresh produce, gourmet foods, and local delicacies in a vibrant and bustling atmosphere.
places.place_tip: Don't miss the Haigh's Chocolates shop for some delicious treats.
places.address: Adelaide Central Market, 44-60 Gouger St, Adelaide SA 5000, Australia

places.name: Flinders Ranges National Park
places.ai_summary: Flinders Ranges National Park is a spectacular outback destination, featuring rugged mountains, deep valleys, and rich Aboriginal history. It's perfect for hiking, camping, and experiencing the Australian wilderness.
places.place_tip: Explore the Wilpena Pound for stunning views and wildlife spotting.
places.address: Flinders Ranges National Park, South Australia, Australia

places.name: Cleland Wildlife Park
places.ai_summary: Cleland Wildlife Park is an interactive wildlife experience, where visitors can get up close and personal with native Australian animals in a beautiful natural setting.
places.place_tip: Bring a hat and sunscreen, and wear comfortable shoes.
places.address: Cleland Wildlife Park, 365 Mount Lofty Summit Rd, Crafers SA 5152, Australia

places.name: Glenelg Beach
places.ai_summary: Glenelg Beach is a popular beach destination, known for its sandy shores, vibrant jetty, and range of water activities. It's ideal for a relaxing day by the sea.

opening_hours.notes: Patrolled by lifeguards during the day.

places.place_tip: Try the local fish and chips at a nearby café.
places.address: Glenelg Beach, Glenelg SA 5045, Australia

places.name: Victor Harbor
places.ai_summary: Victor Harbor is a charming coastal town, famous for its whale watching, historic horse-drawn tram, and beautiful beaches. It's a great spot for a seaside getaway.

opening_hours.notes: Whale watching season is June to September.

places.best_time_to_visit: Winter for whale watching, Summer for beaches
places.place_tip: Take the time to explore the local shops and eateries.
places.address: Victor Harbor, South Australia, Australia

places.name: Adelaide Botanic Garden
places.ai_summary: Adelaide Botanic Garden is a lush, expansive garden in the heart of the city, featuring a vast collection of plants, trees, and flowers from Australia and around the world.
places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to learn about the diverse plant species.
places.address: Adelaide Botanic Garden, Adelaide SA 5000, Australia

attribution.title: Palm House, Adelaide Botanic Gardens
attribution.author: Ashton 29
attribution.description: Exterior of the Palm House at the Royal Botanic Gardens, Adelaide, South Australia.

places.name: South Australian Museum
places.ai_summary: The South Australian Museum is a prominent cultural institution, housing an extensive collection of natural history and cultural artifacts, with a focus on Australia and the Pacific.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Christmas Day and Good Friday.

places.place_tip: Check out the Aboriginal cultural exhibitions.
places.address: South Australian Museum, North Terrace, Adelaide SA 5000, Australia

places.name: Art Gallery of South Australia
places.ai_summary: The Art Gallery of South Australia is an important public gallery, featuring an extensive collection of Australian, European, and Asian art, with significant works by Indigenous artists.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Christmas Day and Good Friday.

places.place_tip: Visit the gallery shop for unique art-inspired gifts.
places.address: Art Gallery of South Australia, North Terrace, Adelaide SA 5000, Australia

attribution.title: Art Gallery of South Australia, North Terrace, Adelaide
attribution.author: Ashton 29
attribution.description: The Art Gallery of South Australia (AGSA), established as the National Gallery of South Australia in 1881, is located in Adelaide. It is the most significant visual arts museum in the Australian state of South Australia. It has a collection of almost 45,000 works of art, making it the second largest state art collection in Australia (after the National Gallery of Victoria). As part of North Terrace cultural precinct, the Gallery is flanked by the South Australian Museum to the west and the University of Adelaide to the east.

places.name: Hahndorf
places.ai_summary: Hahndorf is a charming German settlement in the Adelaide Hills, known for its well-preserved heritage buildings, boutique shops, and traditional German pubs.

opening_hours.notes: Some shops may close earlier in winter.

places.place_tip: Try the local produce and visit the German bakeries.
places.address: Hahndorf, South Australia, Australia

places.name: Naracoorte Caves National Park
places.ai_summary: Naracoorte Caves National Park is a World Heritage site, famous for its limestone caves, stalactites, stalagmites, and rich fossil deposits.
places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to learn about the cave formations and history.
places.address: Naracoorte Caves National Park, South Australia, Australia

places.name: McLaren Vale Wine Region
places.ai_summary: McLaren Vale is a renowned wine region, celebrated for its premium wines, especially Shiraz, and its stunning coastal and vineyard landscapes.
places.place_tip: Visit the local farmers' market for fresh produce and gourmet foods.
places.address: McLaren Vale, South Australia, Australia

places.name: Coober Pedy
places.ai_summary: Coober Pedy is a unique opal mining town, famous for its underground homes, churches, and the stunning Breakaways Reserve.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the cooler months.

places.place_tip: Take a guided tour of an opal mine and the underground town.
places.address: Coober Pedy, South Australia, Australia

places.name: Mount Lofty Summit
places.ai_summary: Mount Lofty Summit offers breathtaking views of the Adelaide city skyline, the coast, and the Adelaide Hills. It's a popular spot for both tourists and locals.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the stunning views.
places.address: Mount Lofty Summit, Mount Lofty SA 5152, Australia

places.name: Monarto Safari Park
places.ai_summary: Monarto Safari Park is one of the world's largest open-range zoos, where visitors can see a wide variety of animals in naturalistic habitats.
places.place_tip: Take a guided tour for a more in-depth experience.
places.address: Monarto Safari Park, Monarto SA 5254, Australia

places.name: Umpherston Sinkhole
places.ai_summary: Umpherston Sinkhole is a unique and picturesque sinkhole, featuring a sunken garden and stunning views. It's a great spot for photography and picnicking.
places.place_tip: Bring a picnic and enjoy the serene environment.
places.address: Umpherston Sinkhole, 1A Jubilee Hwy E, Mount Gambier SA 5290, Australia

places.name: Eyre Peninsula (Shark Cage Diving)
places.ai_summary: The Eyre Peninsula is famous for its stunning coastline, seafood, and adventure activities, including shark cage diving, which offers a thrilling experience for adrenaline seekers.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited from May to October.

places.place_tip: Book shark cage diving in advance for an unforgettable experience.
places.address: Eyre Peninsula, South Australia, Australia

places.name: Adelaide Oval RoofClimb
places.ai_summary: The Adelaide Oval RoofClimb is a unique experience, offering stunning panoramic views of the city, the Adelaide Hills, and beyond from the roof of the iconic Adelaide Oval.
places.best_time_to_visit: Sunrise or sunset for the best views
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes and be prepared for changing weather conditions.
places.address: Adelaide Oval, War Memorial Dr, North Adelaide SA 5006, Australia

places.name: Lake Eyre National Park
places.ai_summary: Lake Eyre National Park is a vast and remote park, famous for its salt flats, unique wildlife, and as a significant site for birdwatching, especially during the migratory season.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the cooler months.

places.place_tip: Check road conditions before visiting, as they can change rapidly.
places.address: Lake Eyre National Park, South Australia, Australia
